'''2023 Champions League''' was the Players Committee Champions League knockout on GEMP, January 2023. [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] defeated [[Joe Olson]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2023-1-champions-league-knockout-round/</ref><ref name="wrap">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/matthew-harrison-trainor-wins-inaugural-champions-league/ Matthew Harrison-Trainor Wins Inaugural Champions League], starwarsccg.org (23 January 2023). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261024141109/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/matthew-harrison-trainor-wins-inaugural-champions-league.html?copy=2 Internet Archive]</ref> [[Bill Kafer]] conceived and directed the event, with help from [[Sam Tashima]];<ref name="wrap" /> play-in games were under way in November 2022.<ref name="dc-1042184777299669062">"'Taco' Bill Kafer, who runs the Champions League which is underway with play-in games", Solidsnack3 in #cantina, SWCCG Players Committee Discord (15 November 2022). [https://discord.com/channels/401469156907679746/401469157587025922/1042184777299669062 Discord message]</ref>

== 2022 group stage and Quarterfinal schedule ==
The Players Committee announced the inaugural Champions League on 16 November 2022 as “New in 2022, the #SWCCG Champions League”, pitting top performers from regional leagues against one another.<ref name="slack-cl22-nov">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Jared Napolitano (JaredNap) / Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 16 November 2022: “New in 2022, the #SWCCG Champions League is ongoing now! Root for your friends in your home region as the top performers in each regional league face off against each other.”</ref> Group-stage play concluded in mid-December 2022, including an 18 December match between 4–0 [[Chris Kelly]] and 3–1 [[Justin Miyashiro]].<ref name="slack-cl22-grp">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Jared Napolitano (JaredNap) / Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 18–19 December 2022: “A pivotal Champions' League match will occur at 7:30pm EST (4:30pm PST) between Chris Kelly and Justin Miyashiro. Chris currently stands at 4-0 with Justin at 3-1.” / “The 2022 #SWCCG Champions League Group Stage is coming in for a landing.”</ref> Quarterfinal elimination matches began later that week on 21 December (No. 2 seed [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] vs. No. 7 [[Brian Fred]]) and 22 December 2022 (No. 4 [[Joe Olson]] vs. No. 5 [[Chris Wirfs]]).<ref name="slack-cl22-qf">Star Wars CCG Slack, #announcements, Jared Napolitano (JaredNap) and James Martin (solidsnck) / Players Committee Twitter feed (@swccg), 21–22 December 2022: “Champions League action continues tonight, with 2. Matthew Harrison-Trainor taking on 7. Brian Fred.” / “4. Joe Olson (picks side) vs. 5. Chris Wirfs”.</ref>

== Discrepancies ==
* '''Winner:''' [[List of SWCCG tournaments]] lists [[Joe Olson]] as the winner of this event, whereas the Players Committee's 23 January 2023 wrap-up report, [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]]'s page, and [[Joe Olson]]'s page all record [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] defeating [[Joe Olson]] in the Final Confrontation.<ref name="wrap" />
